mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_runtime_dag_inputs(tenant_id,session_id,root_input_id,input_id,payload) VALUES(#{tenant},#{session},#{root},#{input},#{payload}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,session_id,input_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT root_input_id,input_id,payload,received_at,state,detail FROM agent_runtime_dag_inputs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND input_id=#{input}

SELECT root_input_id,input_id,payload,received_at,state,detail FROM agent_runtime_dag_inputs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} AND state=#{state} ORDER BY sequence

SELECT root_input_id,input_id,payload,received_at,state,detail FROM agent_runtime_dag_inputs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_runtime_dag_inputs SET state=#{state},detail=#{detail} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} AND input_id=#{input} AND state=#{expected}
